set "CHEF_HOOK="#; exec /bin/sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:?Chef plugin root missing}/hooks/run-python.sh" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:?Chef plugin root missing}/hooks/session_rules.py"; # & python -P -c __import__('runpy').run_path(__import__('os').environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT']+'/hooks/session_rules.py',run_name='__main__') & exit /b
python (Join-Path ([Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT')) 'hooks/session_rules.py'); exit (Get-Variable LASTEXITCODE -ValueOnly -ErrorAction Stop)
